parcel_geography_vintage.county_inferred_from_tract_prefix: For an 11-digit tract GEOID, county is the first five digits.
parcel_geography_vintage.current_lotline_source: 2020–2024 ACS five-year estimates on 2024 ACS tract geography
parcel_geography_vintage.no_tract_fallback: An explicit state-only geography uses state aggregates; if all geography keys are absent, use the configured Pittsburgh-market Allegheny County FIPS 42003 fallback.

bts_latch_2017.geography: 2010 Census tract GEOIDs; exact-code string joins are 2010-code proxies, not Census relationship-file crosswalks
limitations: LATCH is a model transferred from NHTS/ACS characteristics, not observed travel at a parcel or current household.
Current parcel tract codes use 2024 ACS geography; an 11-digit value match does not verify matching tract boundaries.
LATCH values are weekday-only and are not annual household mileage without a separate annualization assumption.
County/state/national fallback means omit source tract records without valid VMT or a positive household weight.
LATCH flag_acs_lt_moe is preserved; it flags ACS predictor uncertainty, not a VMT confidence interval.
bts_latch_2017.measure: Modeled average weekday household vehicle miles traveled per day
bts_latch_2017.publisher: Bureau of Transportation Statistics, U.S. Department of Transportation
bts_latch_2017.title: 2017 Local Area Transportation Characteristics by Household (LATCH) tract CSV
bts_latch_2017.vintage: 2017 modeled estimates using 2017 NHTS travel and 2012–2016 ACS covariates

epa_egrid_2023_reference.measure: Total output emission rate, 916.054 lb CO2e/MWh = 0.415515 kgCO2e/kWh (display 0.416); historical output rate, not a forecast.
epa_egrid_2023_reference.title: eGRID2023, Revision 2 summary data

fhwa_nhts_2017_annualization.geography: United States; driver-level ratio transferred to tract-level LATCH household estimate
limitations: National driver-level weekday/weekend ratio is transferred to household-level LATCH weekday VMT; denominator and geography differ.
Bounds conservatively propagate Table 30 MOE endpoints and are not a formal ratio confidence interval.
261 weekdays plus 104 weekend days represents a non-leap-year calendar.
fhwa_nhts_2017_annualization.publisher: Federal Highway Administration, U.S. Department of Transportation
fhwa_nhts_2017_annualization.table: Table 30, Weekday vs. Weekend, PDF pages 94–95
fhwa_nhts_2017_annualization.title: 2017 National Household Travel Survey: Summary of Travel Trends, Table 30
fhwa_nhts_2017_annualization.vintage: 2017 NHTS original national per-driver VMT statistics

nrel_cambium_2024.geography: Cambium GEA regions; county mapping through ReEDS balancing area
limitations: Cambium is a set of modeled futures, not a forecast; scenario spread is not a confidence interval.
Source points are five years apart and intervening annual rates are linearly interpolated.
End-use-demand basis includes average distribution losses; do not add another line-loss adjustment.
County crosswalk does not verify a parcel's electric utility or meter service territory.
Source horizon ends in 2050; use a disclosed terminal hold or explicit alternative sensitivity after that year.
nrel_cambium_2024.measure: AER load CO2e, direct plus precombustion CO2/CH4/N2O per MWh end-use demand; AR6 100-year GWP; end-use basis includes average distribution losses
